00061 void LFNoise0UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00062 {
00063     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00064     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00065     float currentFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00066     
00067     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00068     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00069     
00070     do {
00071         if (counter <= 0) {
00072             counter = int(UGen::getSampleRate() / max(currentFreq, 0.001f));
00073             counter = max(1, counter);
00074             currentValue = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1,s2,s3);
00075         }
00076         int samplesThisTime = min(numSamplesToProcess, counter);
00077         numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00078         counter -= samplesThisTime;
00079         
00080         while(samplesThisTime--)
00081         {
00082             *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00083         }
00084         
00085     } while (numSamplesToProcess);
00086     
00087     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00088 }

00108 void LFNoise1UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00109 {
00110     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00111     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00112     float currentFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00113     
00114     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00115     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00116     
00117     do {
00118         if (counter <= 0) {
00119             counter = int(UGen::getSampleRate() / max(currentFreq, 0.001f));
00120             counter = max(1, counter);
00121             float nextValue = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1,s2,s3);
00122             slope = (nextValue - currentValue) / counter;
00123         }
00124         int samplesThisTime = min(numSamplesToProcess, counter);
00125         numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00126         counter -= samplesThisTime;
00127         
00128         while(samplesThisTime--)
00129         {
00130             *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00131             currentValue += slope;
00132         }
00133         
00134     } while (numSamplesToProcess);
00135     
00136     random.set(s1, s2, s3);

00139 LFNoise2UGenInternal::LFNoise2UGenInternal(UGen const& freq) throw()
00140 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00141     //random((unsigned int)this * 123463463UL + 423815L + rand(8277)),
00142     random(rand(0x7fffffff)),
00143     currentValue(random.nextBiFloat()),
00144     nextValue(random.nextBiFloat()),
00145     nextMidPoint(nextValue * 0.5f),
00146     curve(0.f),
00147     slope(0.f),
00148     counter(0)
00149 {
00150     inputs[Freq] = freq;
00151     
00152     initValue(currentValue);

00160 void LFNoise2UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00161 {
00162     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00163     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00164     float currentFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00165     
00166     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00167     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00168     
00169     do {
00170         if (counter <= 0) {
00171             float value = nextValue;
00172             nextValue = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1,s2,s3);
00173             currentValue = nextMidPoint;
00174             nextMidPoint = (nextValue + value) * 0.5f;
00175             
00176             counter = int(UGen::getSampleRate() / max(currentFreq, 0.001f));
00177             counter = max(2, counter);
00178             float fseglen = (float)counter;
00179             curve = 2.f * (nextMidPoint - currentValue - fseglen * slope) / (fseglen * fseglen + fseglen);
00180         }
00181         int samplesThisTime = min(numSamplesToProcess, counter);
00182         numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00183         counter -= samplesThisTime;
00184         
00185         while(samplesThisTime--)
00186         {
00187             *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00188             slope += curve;
00189             currentValue += slope;
00190         }
00191         
00192     } while (numSamplesToProcess);
00193     
00194     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00195 }
